prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Value Hint: Displays a reassuring hint on the initial story screen explaining that pet preferences can be customized or changed anytime after setup.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Don't worry, you can customize your pet's path and appearance anytime in settings after adoption."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Compact Layout Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen into a compact layout with structured benefit cards to accelerate narrative progression.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Adopt an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop screen while you work."}}
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Persistence Clarification: Updates sign-in screen messaging to clearly state that signing in saves your pet cloud state and prevents progress resets across reinstalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile", "body": "Signing in ensures your adopted pet data and progress stay safely backed up in the cloud.", "hint": "Use your main account to prevent pet profile resets."}}
3: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Connection Progress Indicator: Adds a visual progress bar component and connection status message to the sign-in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"show_progress": true, "hint": "Connecting securely to pet authentication servers...", "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [adoption, reorder] Reorder Photo Upload Before Selection: Reorders the adoption screens so photo upload happens prior to selecting the friend and issuing the certificate.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "pick_friend", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Generation Guidance Screen: Inserts a dedicated custom pet photo guidelines screen before uploading to ensure successful pet generation.
   config: {"new_photo_guidelines": {"headline": "Custom Pet Photo Tips", "body": "Follow these quick tips for the best custom pet results.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "text": "Use high resolution images with clear subject lighting"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_guidelines", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid View Layout: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a grid layout to make comparing pet options faster and easier.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Choose a pet companion to join your desktop environment."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Pet Spawn Status Progress Visualizer: Enables progress indicators and desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet Environment", "body": "Preparing screen overlays and pet assets for launch."}}
8: [finish, new_flow] Post-Onboarding Control Overview Flow: Adds a dedicated control summary screen at the end of onboarding highlighting desktop interaction key combinations.
   config: {"new_control_summary": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls Overview", "body": "Quick guide on how to interact with, move, or hide your pet on screen.", "layout": "two_column", "components": [{"type": "text", "style": "highlight", "text": "Click pet to interact | Right click desktop icon for options"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_control_summary"]}
9: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Interaction Guide Copy: Updates the home_intro copy to explain basic desktop actions such as clicking to interact and right-clicking to manage overlay settings.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Active!", "body": "Your new pet is now roaming your screen. Left click your pet to interact, or right click the system tray icon for menu options.", "hint": "You can move or hide your pet anytime from the tray menu."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid onboarding copy addition with no rule violations.
Redesigns story screen while preserving its core job of introducing the pet.
Clarifies sign-in messaging within onboarding limits.
Adds visual progress indicator to sign-in screen without violating fair design.
Reordering onboarding steps is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adding a new photo guidelines screen inside onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Changes pick_friend layout to grid while retaining pet selection functionality.
Adds progress visualization to the waiting screen while retaining its core function.
Adding a new screen following home_intro within onboarding is permitted by Rule 4.
Updates home_intro onboarding copy without touching outside screens or pricing.
